{{Orphan|date=August 2024}}

{{Use dmy dates|date=July 2019}}
'''Palash Kumar''' is an Indian [[mathematician]]. He holds a position at the  [[Indian Statistical Institute]].

He was awarded in 2011 the   [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], the highest science award in [[India]],  in the mathematical sciences category.<ref name="ibn">{{cite news | url=http://ibnlive.in.com/generalnewsfeed/news/11-scientists-selected-for-shanti-swarup-bhatnagar-award/836081.html | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110929193539/http://ibnlive.in.com/generalnewsfeed/news/11-scientists-selected-for-shanti-swarup-bhatnagar-award/836081.html | url-status=dead | archive-date=September 29, 2011 | title=11 scientists selected for Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar award | date=Sep 26, 2011 | agency=''[[CNN-IBN|IBN Live]]'' | accessdate=December 20, 2011 | author=PTI | author-link=Press Trust of India | location=[[New Delhi]]}}</ref>
